EXCELLENT local food, great service
Apr 2026 • Solo
One of the best restaurants in all of Hanoi. VERY Friendly staff, excellent fresh Vietnamese local food, quick, made-to order if you want, good beer choices. Inexpensive. When you walk by them in the AM, they also sell fresh veggies before they open and so you get to see what you’ll be eating later. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Written April 21, 2026

Corner food, fantastic
Mar 2026 • Couples
We found this little gem and have eaten here every day whilst in Hanoi. The food is fresh and I would say the best I've eaten in my entire trip. Andy & family run this place and are so hospitable.

The menu is varied and there is something for everyone. It's great value. Get yourself here, you won't regret it. The Pho soup is to die for! 
I'll definitely be back! Thank you!
